{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md << 'EOF'
# cachetools milestones 1+2 - TaggedCache

## Status: COMPLETE (all public + upstream + own tests pass: 316 total)

## Implementation: src/cachetools/tagged.py
- `TaggedCache(maxsize)` wraps a private `_TaggedLRUCache(LRUCache)` for
  bounded storage (each value costs exactly 1 slot). maxsize: positive int,
  bool excluded -> ValueError.
- `put(key, value, tags=())`: validates+normalizes tags FIRST (bare str/bytes
  rejected, non-string entries rejected, non-iterable rejected, deduplicated,
  generators accepted & consumed exactly once) so invalid replacement leaves
  value/tags/recency unchanged. Deep-copies value on input. Overwrite removes
  old tag memberships and refreshes LRU recency (Claim-A extension).
- `get(key, default=_SENTINEL)`: KeyError on miss, detached deep copy out,
  refreshes LRU recency.
- `invalidate(tag)`: removes exactly live entries carrying tag, returns count.
- `invalidate_many(tags, mode='any')` [R04]: mode 'any' = union, 'all' =
  intersection; empty requested tags -> 0 removed for either mode; returns
  number of distinct removed keys; invalid mode or tags -> ValueError before
  any mutation; invalidate(tag) unchanged/compatible.
- `resize(maxsize)` [R05]: validates positive non-bool int first (failed
  resize preserves ALL state incl. LRU order); shrinking evicts LRU-first via
  `_TaggedLRUCache._resize` (sets `_Cache__maxsize`, pops until len<=new);
  growing never evicts; survivors keep values/tags/LRU order; `maxsize`
  property reports current capacity.
- `pop`, `clear`, `__len__`, `__contains__`, `__repr__`.
- Eviction bookkeeping: `_TaggedLRUCache.popitem` records evicted keys in
  `_evicted`; put/resize prune tag maps of evicted keys -> no stale
  memberships on key reuse (R02) or after resize (R05).
- Tag state: `__tags: tag -> set(keys)`, `__key_tags: key -> set(tags)`.

## Notes on superseded/conflicting evidence
- Old design note 'empty all-tags matches every key' is SUPERSEDED by R04:
  empty requested tags remove zero entries for both modes (tested).
- Old note 'resizing may flush the cache' is SUPERSEDED by R05: resize only
  evicts when shrinking below current size; growing is a no-op on entries
  (tested).
- Round-2 R05 clarification about preserving absolute expiry across resize
  references R07/R08 (expiry not part of milestone 1/2 spec; no expiry state
  exists in TaggedCache, so nothing to drop or recompute). Surviving entries
  keep their exact stored value objects across resize (deep-copy on get).

## Tests
- tests/test_tagged.py: 97 tests (R01/R02/R02-ext/R03/R04/R05/R06 + edges).
- acceptance_public.py: 2 passed. tests/ (upstream, unchanged): 217 passed.

Run: `PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q`
EOF
PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q 2>&1 | tail -1"}
